---
title: "Create Multiome Object"
format: html
execute:
  warning: false
  message: false
---

## Purpose

Create a paired RNA and ATAC Seurat object from count matrices and metadata.

## Packages

```{r}
#| label: tpl-multiome-01-create-multiome-object-packages
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Load only the packages used in this template.
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(Signac)
  library(qs2)
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
})
```

## User Config

```{r}
#| label: tpl-multiome-01-create-multiome-object-user-config
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# USER INPUT:
input_object <- "path/to/rna_count_matrix.qs"
atac_counts_object <- "path/to/atac_peak_count_matrix.qs"
metadata_file <- "path/to/cell_metadata.tsv"
fragments_file <- "path/to/fragments.tsv.gz"
output_object <- "path/to/multiome_created.qs"
results_dir <- "results/create_multiome"
figures_dir <- "figures/create_multiome"
rna_assay <- "RNA"
atac_assay <- "peaks"
sample_column <- "sample_column"
group_column <- "group_column"
genome_name <- "genome_placeholder"
seed <- 1
n_threads <- 4
compress_level <- 6
```

## Input Loading

```{r}
#| label: tpl-multiome-01-create-multiome-object-input-loading
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Create output folders and load configured inputs.
set.seed(seed)
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(figures_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
rna_counts <- qs2::qs_read(file = input_object, nthreads = n_threads)
atac_counts <- qs2::qs_read(file = atac_counts_object, nthreads = n_threads)
metadata <- readr::read_tsv(metadata_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## Validation

```{r}
#| label: tpl-multiome-01-create-multiome-object-validation
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Stop early when required inputs or columns are missing.
stopifnot(all(colnames(rna_counts) == colnames(atac_counts)))
stopifnot(all(c(sample_column, group_column) %in% colnames(metadata)))
stopifnot(file.exists(fragments_file))
```

## Input Summary

```{r}
#| label: tpl-multiome-01-create-multiome-object-input-summary
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Write a small TSV summary of the loaded input.
readr::write_tsv(tibble::tibble(cells = ncol(rna_counts), genes = nrow(rna_counts), peaks = nrow(atac_counts)), file.path(results_dir, "multiome_input_summary.tsv"))
```

## Main Analysis

```{r}
#| label: tpl-multiome-01-create-multiome-object-main-analysis
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Run the reusable analysis step for this template.
metadata <- metadata |> tibble::column_to_rownames(colnames(metadata)[1])
object <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = rna_counts, assay = rna_assay, meta.data = metadata[colnames(rna_counts), , drop = FALSE])
object[[atac_assay]] <- CreateChromatinAssay(counts = atac_counts, sep = c(":", "-"), genome = genome_name, fragments = fragments_file)
```

## QC Checks

```{r}
#| label: tpl-multiome-01-create-multiome-object-qc-checks
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Export checks that make failures easy to inspect.
DefaultAssay(object) <- atac_assay
object <- NucleosomeSignal(object)
object <- TSSEnrichment(object)
readr::write_tsv(object[[]] |> tibble::rownames_to_column("cell_id"), file.path(results_dir, "multiome_qc_metrics.tsv"))
```

## Visualization

```{r}
#| label: tpl-multiome-01-create-multiome-object-visualization
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Save compact figures for the main outputs.
pdf(file.path(figures_dir, "multiome_qc.pdf"), width = 8, height = 4)
print(VlnPlot(object, features = c("nCount_RNA", "nCount_peaks", "TSS.enrichment"), group.by = sample_column, pt.size = 0))
dev.off()
```

## Object Result Storage

```{r}
#| label: tpl-multiome-01-create-multiome-object-object-result-storage
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Store reusable analysis metadata inside the object.
object@misc$template <- list(step = "create_multiome_object", rna_assay = rna_assay, atac_assay = atac_assay)
```

## Result Export

```{r}
#| label: tpl-multiome-01-create-multiome-object-result-export
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Export the main reusable tables as TSV files.
readr::write_tsv(object[[]] |> tibble::rownames_to_column("cell_id"), file.path(results_dir, "created_multiome_metadata.tsv"))
```

## Final Save

```{r}
#| label: tpl-multiome-01-create-multiome-object-final-save
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Save the updated object for the next template step.
qs2::qs_save(object, file = output_object, nthreads = n_threads, compress_level = compress_level)
```

## Output Summary

```{r}
#| label: tpl-multiome-01-create-multiome-object-output-summary
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Print a compact summary of generated outputs.
tibble::tibble(output_object = output_object, cells = ncol(object), assays = paste(Assays(object), collapse = ","))
```
